title: DEPHYRIER Quatro Entradas (Handover Human Support)
style: governance pulse 96 bpm trilingual EN PT FR DEPHYRIER signature handover-doc consolidation-tone soft-pad upright-bass spoken-portuguese
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
April twenty four fifty eight AM the post arrived
Handover human support the doc survived
Four inputs consolidated into one file clean
Nicaragua governance path on the screen

[Pre-Chorus — Portuguese]
Quatro entradas um documento o caminho traçado
(Four inputs one document the path traced)
A escalada governança não é um recado
(The governance escalation is not a passing note)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER handover four into one
Quatro pontos um arquivo o trabalho está pronto
(Four points one file the work is done)
Quatre entrées un dossier la route est tracée
(Four inputs one file the route is traced)

[Verse 2]
Docs slash HANDOVER underscore HUMAN underscore SUPPORT
Two zero two six dash zero four dash twenty the report
Not a vibe not a draft a committed path
Governance escalation written without wrath

[Bridge — French]
Le document existe la route est inscrite
(The document exists the route is written)
Le support humain n'est pas une fuite
(Human support is not a flight)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER quatro entradas one file done
Le dossier est là o documento está
DEPHYRIER handover signed and gone
